repos.description: An open-source long-horizon SuperAgent harness that researches, codes, and creates. With the help of sandboxes, memories, tools, skill, subagents and message gateway, it handles different levels of tasks that could take minutes to hours.
repos.summary_zh: DeerFlow 是字节跳动开源的超级智能体框架，通过协调子智能体、记忆系统和沙箱环境，处理分钟级到小时级的复杂研究与创作任务。其核心在于可扩展技能体系与上下文工程，支持长期记忆持久化与文件系统操作，为构建自主智能体应用提供生产级基础设施。
repos.summary_en: DeerFlow is an open-source SuperAgent harness by Bytedance that orchestrates sub-agents, memory, and sandboxes to handle complex research, coding, and creative tasks spanning minutes to hours. Featuring extensible skills, context engineering, and long-term memory persistence, it provides production-grade infrastructure for building autonomous agent applications.

repos.description: VoxCPM2: Tokenizer-Free TTS for Multilingual Speech Generation, Creative Voice Design, and True-to-Life Cloning
repos.summary_zh: VoxCPM2是开源的Tokenizer-Free文本转语音系统，基于2B参数Diffusion自回归架构，训练于200万小时多语言数据。支持30种语言合成、自然语言驱动的声音创意设计、48kHz高保真声音克隆及实时流式生成。其端到端设计绕过离散标记化，实现更自然、更具表现力的语音合成，适用于多语言内容创作、个性化语音助手等场景。
repos.summary_en: VoxCPM2 is an open-source tokenizer-free Text-to-Speech system built on a 2B-parameter diffusion autoregressive architecture trained on over 2 million hours of multilingual speech data. It enables 30-language synthesis, natural language-based voice design, controllable voice cloning, and ultimate cloning with 48kHz studio-quality output. The end-to-end model bypasses discrete tokenization for highly natural and expressive speech generation, supporting real-time streaming with RTF as low as 0.13 via vLLM acceleration, ideal for creative content production and personalized voice applications.

repos.description: 100+ open-source clones of popular sites like Airbnb, Amazon, Instagram, Netflix, Tiktok, Spotify, Whatsapp, Youtube etc. See source code, demo links, tech stack, github stars.
repos.summary_zh: Clone Wars是一个GitHub开源仓库，收录100多个流行网站和应用的开源克隆与替代项目，包括Airbnb、Instagram、Netflix、Spotify等。提供源码、演示链接、技术栈及星标数据，专为学习设计。分带教程的克隆表和普通克隆/替代表，展示React、Next.js、Firebase、Django等多种技术栈。核心价值是curated学习资源，帮助开发者通过实际项目掌握全栈开发、构建作品集并探索开源替代方案。
repos.summary_en: Clone Wars is a curated GitHub repository featuring 100+ open-source clones and alternatives to popular sites like Airbnb, Instagram, Netflix, and Spotify. It includes source code links, demos, tech stacks, and star counts for learning web development. Divided into a tutorials table for guided full-stack projects and a clones/alternatives table distinguishing UI clones from functional alternatives. Showcasing technologies such as React, Next.js, Firebase, and more, it enables developers to explore implementations of popular features, enhance skills through practical examples, and find open-source substitutes. Perfect for self-learners and portfolio building.

repos.description: The most advanced free and open-source browser fingerprinting library
repos.summary_zh: FingerprintJS是最先进的免费开源浏览器指纹识别库，通过客户端查询浏览器属性计算哈希访客标识符。与Cookie不同，它在隐身模式和清除数据后仍保持一致。适用于访客识别、欺诈检测和Web分析等场景。技术亮点包括npm/CDN简单安装、MIT许可、高兼容性和React支持。提供演示展示持久性，但准确性低于商业版且易被欺骗。
repos.summary_en: FingerprintJS is the most advanced free and open-source browser fingerprinting library. It generates a unique hashed visitor identifier by querying browser attributes on the client-side. Unlike cookies, the fingerprint remains consistent in incognito mode and after clearing browser data. It is ideal for visitor identification, fraud detection, and analytics in web applications. Key highlights include easy installation via npm or CDN, MIT license, high compatibility, and React support. A demo is available to showcase its persistence. However, it has lower accuracy than commercial versions and is vulnerable to spoofing.

repos.description: The most powerful local music generation model that outperforms almost all commercial alternatives, supporting Mac, AMD, Intel, and CUDA devices.
repos.summary_zh: ACE-Step 1.5 是开源音乐生成基础模型，采用语言模型与扩散Transformer混合架构，通过内在强化学习实现商业级音质。支持50+语言歌词生成与1000+音乐风格，可在4GB显存设备本地运行，A100上生成速度达2秒/首。提供音频编辑、人声转伴奏等创作工具，赋能音乐制作人与内容创作者。
repos.summary_en: ACE-Step 1.5 is an open-source music foundation model featuring a hybrid LM-DiT architecture with intrinsic reinforcement learning, delivering commercial-grade audio quality on consumer hardware (<4GB VRAM). It generates full songs in under 2 seconds on A100, supports 50+ languages and 1000+ musical styles, and offers versatile editing tools including vocal-to-BGM conversion and multi-track generation. The model enables lightweight personalization through LoRA training with minimal data, revolutionizing AI-assisted music creation for producers and content creators.

repos.description: Gradio WebUI for creators and developers, featuring key TTS (Edge-TTS, kokoro) and zero-shot Voice Cloning (E2 & F5-TTS, CosyVoice), with Whisper audio processing, YouTube download, Demucs vocal isolation, and multilingual translation.
repos.summary_zh: Voice-Pro是集YouTube视频下载、人声分离、语音识别、多语言翻译与TTS于一体的AI音频创作平台。基于Gradio构建，集成Whisper、F5-TTS、CosyVoice等前沿模型，支持零样本语音克隆与高质量配音，为创作者提供一站式多语言内容本地化解决方案，显著提升跨语言内容生产效率。
repos.summary_en: Voice-Pro is an all-in-one AI audio creation platform that seamlessly integrates YouTube video downloading, vocal isolation, speech recognition, multilingual translation and text-to-speech capabilities. Built on Gradio with cutting-edge models including Whisper, F5-TTS, E2-TTS and CosyVoice, it enables zero-shot voice cloning and professional-grade dubbing. The platform provides creators and developers with a comprehensive solution for multilingual content localization, significantly enhancing cross-lingual content production efficiency.

repos.description: 3FUI 是 ffmpeg 在 Windows 上的轻度专业交互外壳，收录大量参数，界面美观，交互友好。此项目面向国内使用环境，让普通人也能够轻松压制视频和转换格式。
repos.summary_zh: 3FUI是Windows平台FFmpeg的专业交互外壳，基于.NET 10与WinForm框架开发。集成40+视频编码器（含硬件加速）、20+音频及10+图片编码器，支持深度自定义参数与无限制批量任务。面向追求参数透明与压制质量的专业用户，提供简洁高效的暗黑风格界面，无广告完全免费，需自备FFmpeg二进制以获得最新性能。
repos.summary_en: 3FUI is a professional interactive shell for FFmpeg on Windows, developed with .NET 10 and WinForm. It integrates 40+ video encoders (including hardware acceleration), 20+ audio and 10+ image encoders, supporting deep custom parameters and unlimited batch processing. Designed for professionals seeking transparent control and high-quality output, it features a clean dark-mode interface, is ad-free and completely free. Users must provide their own FFmpeg binary for optimal performance.

repos.description: 一款专注于 AI 多模态翻译的工具，一键自动翻译 RPG/SLG 游戏、Epub/TXT 小说、PDF/Word/MD 文档、Srt/Ass/Vtt 字幕，以及漫画图片、音频与视频等内容。
repos.summary_zh: AiNiee 是一款专注于复杂长文本 AI 翻译的工具，支持游戏、电子书、文档、字幕等全格式一键翻译。采用思维链翻译、上下文关联和 AI 术语表技术突破长文本翻译局限，深度适配 Mtool、Renpy 等游戏提取工具，提供术语提取、AI 润色等质量控制功能，实现高效高质量的多领域翻译。
repos.summary_en: AiNiee is an AI-powered translation tool specialized in complex long-text translation across games, ebooks, documents, and subtitles. It employs chain-of-thought translation, contextual association, and AI glossary to overcome long-text limitations. With deep integration of game extraction tools like Mtool and Renpy, it offers terminology extraction and AI polishing features for efficient, high-quality multilingual translation.

repos.description: An AI-Powered Speech Processing Toolkit and Open Source SOTA Pretrained Models, Supporting Speech Enhancement, Separation, and Target Speaker Extraction, etc.
repos.summary_zh: ClearerVoice-Studio是阿里巴巴开源的AI语音处理工具包，集成语音增强、分离、超分辨率及目标说话人提取等SOTA预训练模型。支持10+音频格式与立体声处理，提供灵活的NumPy接口和完整训练/推理脚本。其FRCRN降噪模型已在ModelScope被调用超300万次，为研究、开发和生产提供一站式解决方案。
repos.summary_en: ClearerVoice-Studio is an open-source AI-powered speech processing toolkit by Alibaba, featuring SOTA pretrained models for speech enhancement, separation, super-resolution, and target speaker extraction. Supporting 10+ audio formats with stereo processing, it offers flexible NumPy interfaces and comprehensive training/inference scripts. Its FRCRN denoiser has surpassed 3 million uses on ModelScope, delivering a production-ready solution for researchers and developers.

repos.description: Transcribe and summarize videos and podcasts using AI. Open-source, multi-platform, and supports multiple languages.
repos.summary_zh: 开源AI视频转写工具，支持YouTube、TikTok、Bilibili等30+平台及本地音视频文件。采用字幕优先架构，无字幕时调用Faster-Whisper实现高精度语音识别，经AI优化后生成多语言摘要。支持任意OpenAI兼容API，Docker部署，适合内容创作者与研究者快速提取视频核心内容。
repos.summary_en: An open-source AI-powered video and podcast transcription tool supporting 30+ platforms including YouTube, TikTok, and Bilibili, plus local audio/video file uploads. Its subtitle-first architecture extracts native subtitles instantly when available, using Faster-Whisper as fallback for high-accuracy speech recognition. The tool leverages any OpenAI-compatible API for intelligent text optimization, typo correction, and multi-language summarization. Built with FFmpeg for media processing and Docker support, it's ideal for content creators, researchers, and educators to efficiently convert multimedia content into structured, searchable text with AI-enhanced summaries.
